entry.title: New: Resolution 305 (2024-2026) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
AUTHORIZES THE MAYOR TO ENTER INTO AN INTERGOVERNMENTAL AGREEMENT WITH THE HONOLULU POLICE DEPARTMENT, SCIENTIFIC INVESTIGATION SECTION, FOR INTERAGENCY PUBLIC SAFETY COORDINATION

Authorizes the Hawaiʻi Police Department to enter into a Memorandum of Understanding for use of the Honolulu Police Department’s full-service forensic testing laboratory.
